description: Update a clockin employee (PATCH /employees/{id}). Required: id, changes (clockin needs first_name, last_name, email in every update — fetch the employee first).

changes.description: Fields to change (clockin expects the required fields of the object in every update)

app_language.description: App language, e.g. de or en

device_ids.description: IDs of clockin devices/terminals the employee may use

pin_change_required.description: Employee must change the PIN at next login

name: update_clockin_employee
